text:
The British man who died in a shooting in Kraków has been named as 32-year-old James Campbell.
Campbell, of Prestwick, South Ayrshire, was one of six people killed in the 7 November shooting in the Polish city by the 24-year-old gunman, who is also suspected of murdering three members of his own family.
Another British man was injured by the shooter, and local officials previously said three of the women and one man who were killed were Polish.
More details soon …
